question: In a certain code language, ‘FAR’ is written as ‘SARF’ and ‘PICK’ is written as ‘SICKP’. How will ‘BLACK’ be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca107beda2547c6502257871c76889877cfb676c4f2b124fb99ee72c3ef93971.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘FAR’ is written as ‘SARF’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0463039cbb05890cb82c2ad9ac05f466bac44689822f76c203db4cad1f906788.png] 

‘PICK’ is written as ‘SICKP’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3d89df2a1cadd63c06991fe55cd191348e313c4d23cc3fde0acbc7194c0525b.png] 

Similarly, for ‘BLACK’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f2badffe1ae9e2d399e7fdac74fc96305f7c19524eafa75209a16105c1af2ac.png] 

So, 'BLACJ' will be written as 'SLACKB'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
